content:
I will send fire on the house of Hazael
    that will consume the fortresses of Ben-Hadad.

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding nations

content:
I will break down the gate of Damascus;
    I will destroy the king who is in the Valley of Aven
  and the one who holds the scepter in Beth Eden.
    The people of Aram will go into exile to Kir,”
    says the Lord.

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding nations

content:
I will send fire on the walls of Gaza
    that will consume her fortresses.

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Tyre,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  Because she sold whole communities of captives to Edom,
    disregarding a treaty of brotherhood,

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Ammon,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  Because he ripped open the pregnant women of Gilead
    in order to extend his borders,

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content: The words of Amos, one of the shepherds of Tekoa—the vision he saw concerning Israel two years before the earthquake, when Uzziah was king of Judah and Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel.

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding nations

content:
He said:
  “The Lord roars from Zion
    and thunders from Jerusalem;
  the pastures of the shepherds dry up,
    and the top of Carmel withers.”

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding nations

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Edom,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  Because he pursued his brother with a sword
    and slaughtered the women of the land,
  because his anger raged continually
    and his fury flamed unchecked,

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
I will send fire on Teman
    that will consume the fortresses of Bozrah.”

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
I will set fire to the walls of Rabbah
    that will consume her fortresses
  amid war cries on the day of battle,
    amid violent winds on a stormy day.

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Gaza,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  Because she took captive whole communities
    and sold them to Edom,

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
I will send fire on the walls of Tyre
    that will consume her fortresses.”

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Damascus,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  Because she threshed Gilead
    with sledges having iron teeth,

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding nations

content:
I will destroy the king of Ashdod
    and the one who holds the scepter in Ashkelon.
  I will turn my hand against Ekron,
    till the last of the Philistines are dead,”
    says the Sovereign Lord.

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
Her king will go into exile,
    he and his officials together,”
    says the Lord.

teaching.name: Judgement on surrounding areas

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Moab,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  Because he burned to ashes
    the bones of Edom’s king,

teaching.name: Judgement against Moab and Judah

content:
I will send fire on Moab
    that will consume the fortresses of Kerioth.
  Moab will go down in great tumult
    amid war cries and the blast of the trumpet.

teaching.name: Judgement against Moab and Judah

content:
I will send fire on Judah
    that will consume the fortresses of Jerusalem.”

teaching.name: Judgement against Moab and Judah

content:
They trample on the heads of the poor
    as on the dust of the ground
    and deny justice to the oppressed.
  Father and son use the same girl
    and so profane my holy name.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 1

content:
I brought you up out of Egypt
    and led you forty years in the wilderness
    to give you the land of the Amorites.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
“Now then, I will crush you
    as a cart crushes when loaded with grain.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
Even the bravest warriors
    will flee naked on that day,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Judah,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  Because they have rejected the law of the Lord
    and have not kept his decrees,
  because they have been led astray by false gods,
    the gods their ancestors followed,

teaching.name: Judgement against Moab and Judah

content:
“Yet I destroyed the Amorites before them,
    though they were tall as the cedars
    and strong as the oaks.
  I destroyed their fruit above
    and their roots below.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
The swift will not escape,
    the strong will not muster their strength,
    and the warrior will not save his life.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
The archer will not stand his ground,
    the fleet-footed soldier will not get away,
    and the horseman will not save his life.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
I will destroy her ruler
    and kill all her officials with him,”
    says the Lord.

teaching.name: Judgement against Moab and Judah

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “For three sins of Israel,
    even for four, I will not relent.
  They sell the innocent for silver,
    and the needy for a pair of sandals.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 1

content:
They lie down beside every altar
    on garments taken in pledge.
  In the house of their god
    they drink wine taken as fines.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 1

content:
“I also raised up prophets from among your children
    and Nazirites from among your youths.
  Is this not true, people of Israel?”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
“But you made the Nazirites drink wine
    and commanded the prophets not to prophesy.

teaching.name: Judgement against Israel 2

content:
Does a lion roar in the thicket
    when it has no prey?
  Does it growl in its den
    when it has caught nothing?

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
Surely the Sovereign Lord does nothing
    without revealing his plan
    to his servants the prophets.

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “As a shepherd rescues from the lion’s mouth
    only two leg bones or a piece of an ear,
  so will the Israelites living in Samaria be rescued,
    with only the head of a bed
    and a piece of fabric from a couch.”

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 2

content: “Hear this and testify against the descendants of Jacob,” declares the Lord, the Lord God Almighty.

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 2

content:
“On the day I punish Israel for her sins,
    I will destroy the altars of Bethel;
  the horns of the altar will be cut off
    and fall to the ground.

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 2

content: Hear this word, people of Israel, the word the Lord has spoken against you—against the whole family I brought up out of Egypt:

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
Does a bird swoop down to a trap on the ground
    when no bait is there?
  Does a trap spring up from the ground
    if it has not caught anything?

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
The lion has roared—
    who will not fear?
  The Sovereign Lord has spoken—
    who can but prophesy?

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
Proclaim to the fortresses of Ashdod
    and to the fortresses of Egypt:
  “Assemble yourselves on the mountains of Samaria;
    see the great unrest within her
    and the oppression among her people.”

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 2

content:
I will tear down the winter house
    along with the summer house;
  the houses adorned with ivory will be destroyed
    and the mansions will be demolished,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 2

content:
“They do not know how to do right,” declares the Lord,
    “who store up in their fortresses
    what they have plundered and looted.”

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 2

content:
Therefore this is what the Sovereign Lord says:
  “An enemy will overrun your land,
    pull down your strongholds
    and plunder your fortresses.”

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 2

content:
“You only have I chosen
    of all the families of the earth;
  therefore I will punish you
    for all your sins.”

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
Do two walk together
    unless they have agreed to do so?

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
When a trumpet sounds in a city,
    do not the people tremble?
  When disaster comes to a city,
    has not the Lord caused it?

teaching.name: God's charge against the whole house of Israel 1

content:
“Go to Bethel and sin;
    go to Gilgal and sin yet more.
  Bring your sacrifices every morning,
    your tithes every three years.

teaching.name: Israel punished in the past for iniquity

content:
“I overthrew some of you
    as I overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
  You were like a burning stick snatched from the fire,
    yet you have not returned to me,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
“Therefore this is what I will do to you, Israel,
    and because I will do this to you, Israel,
    prepare to meet your God.”

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
He who forms the mountains,
    who creates the wind,
    and who reveals his thoughts to mankind,
  who turns dawn to darkness,
    and treads on the heights of the earth—
    the Lord God Almighty is his name.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
“I gave you empty stomachs in every city
    and lack of bread in every town,
  yet you have not returned to me,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
Hear this word, you cows of Bashan on Mount Samaria,
    you women who oppress the poor and crush the needy
    and say to your husbands, “Bring us some drinks!”

teaching.name: Israel punished in the past for iniquity

content:
The Sovereign Lord has sworn by his holiness:
    “The time will surely come
  when you will be taken away with hooks,
    the last of you with fishhooks.

teaching.name: Israel punished in the past for iniquity

content:
You will each go straight out
    through breaches in the wall.
  You will be cast out toward Harmon,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel punished in the past for iniquity

content:
“I also withheld rain from you
    when the harvest was still three months away.
  I sent rain on one town,
    but withheld it from another.
  One field had rain;
    another had none and dried up.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
Burn leavened bread as a thank offering
    and brag about your freewill offerings—
  boast about them, you Israelites,
    for this is what you love to do,”
    declares the Sovereign Lord.

teaching.name: Israel punished in the past for iniquity

content:
People staggered from town to town for water
    but did not get enough to drink,
  yet you have not returned to me,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
“Many times I struck your gardens and vineyards,
    destroying them with blight and mildew.
  Locusts devoured your fig and olive trees,
    yet you have not returned to me,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
“I sent plagues among you
    as I did to Egypt.
  I killed your young men with the sword,
    along with your captured horses.
  I filled your nostrils with the stench of your camps,
    yet you have not returned to me,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the past for iniquity

content:
Seek the Lord and live,
    or he will sweep through the tribes of Joseph like a fire;
  it will devour them,
    and Bethel will have no one to quench it.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 1

content:
There are those who hate the one who upholds justice in court
    and detest the one who tells the truth.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
Seek good, not evil,
    that you may live.
  Then the Lord God Almighty will be with you,
    just as you say he is.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
You have lifted up the shrine of your king,
    the pedestal of your idols,
    the star of your god—
    which you made for yourselves.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
do not seek Bethel,
  do not go to Gilgal,
    do not journey to Beersheba.
  For Gilgal will surely go into exile,
    and Bethel will be reduced to nothing.”

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 1

content:
You levy a straw tax on the poor
    and impose a tax on their grain.
  Therefore, though you have built stone mansions,
    you will not live in them;
  though you have planted lush vineyards,
    you will not drink their wine.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
Therefore the prudent keep quiet in such times,
    for the times are evil.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
Therefore this is what the Lord, the Lord God Almighty, says:
  “There will be wailing in all the streets
    and cries of anguish in every public square.
  The farmers will be summoned to weep
    and the mourners to wail.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
Will not the day of the Lord be darkness, not light—
    pitch-dark, without a ray of brightness?

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content: Hear this word, Israel, this lament I take up concerning you:

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 1

content:
“Fallen is Virgin Israel,
    never to rise again,
  deserted in her own land,
    with no one to lift her up.”

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 1

content:
With a blinding flash he destroys the stronghold
    and brings the fortified city to ruin.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
Hate evil, love good;
    maintain justice in the courts.
  Perhaps the Lord God Almighty will have mercy
    on the remnant of Joseph.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
There will be wailing in all the vineyards,
    for I will pass through your midst,”
    says the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
“I hate, I despise your religious festivals;
    your assemblies are a stench to me.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
Even though you bring me burnt offerings and grain offerings,
    I will not accept them.
  Though you bring choice fellowship offerings,
    I will have no regard for them.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
Therefore I will send you into exile beyond Damascus,”
    says the Lord, whose name is God Almighty.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
This is what the Sovereign Lord says to Israel:
  “Your city that marches out a thousand strong
    will have only a hundred left;
  your town that marches out a hundred strong
    will have only ten left.”

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 1

content:
This is what the Lord says to Israel:
  “Seek me and live;

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 1

content:
There are those who turn justice into bitterness
    and cast righteousness to the ground.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 1

content:
He who made the Pleiades and Orion,
    who turns midnight into dawn
    and darkens day into night,
  who calls for the waters of the sea
    and pours them out over the face of the land—
    the Lord is his name.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
For I know how many are your offenses
    and how great your sins.
    
  There are those who oppress the innocent and take bribes
    and deprive the poor of justice in the courts.

teaching.name: Israel's punishment in the future for iniquity 2

content:
Woe to you who long
    for the day of the Lord!
  Why do you long for the day of the Lord?
    That day will be darkness, not light.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
It will be as though a man fled from a lion
    only to meet a bear,
  as though he entered his house
    and rested his hand on the wall
    only to have a snake bite him.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
Away with the noise of your songs!
    I will not listen to the music of your harps.

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
But let justice roll on like a river,
    righteousness like a never-failing stream!

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
“Did you bring me sacrifices and offerings
    forty years in the wilderness, people of Israel?

teaching.name: Israel will be punished in the future

content:
Go to Kalneh and look at it;
    go from there to great Hamath,
    and then go down to Gath in Philistia.
  Are they better off than your two kingdoms?
    Is their land larger than yours?

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 1

content:
You put off the day of disaster
    and bring near a reign of terror.

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 1

content:
You lie on beds adorned with ivory
    and lounge on your couches.
  You dine on choice lambs
    and fattened calves.

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 1

content:
You drink wine by the bowlful
    and use the finest lotions,
    but you do not grieve over the ruin of Joseph.

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 1

content:
Therefore you will be among the first to go into exile;
    your feasting and lounging will end.

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content:
For the Lord has given the command,
    and he will smash the great house into pieces
    and the small house into bits.

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content:
Woe to you who are complacent in Zion,
    and to you who feel secure on Mount Samaria,
  you notable men of the foremost nation,
    to whom the people of Israel come!

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 1

content:
The Sovereign Lord has sworn by himself—the Lord God Almighty declares:
  “I abhor the pride of Jacob
    and detest his fortresses;
  I will deliver up the city
    and everything in it.”

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content:
Do horses run on the rocky crags?
    Does one plow the sea with oxen?
  But you have turned justice into poison
    and the fruit of righteousness into bitterness—

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content:
For the Lord God Almighty declares,
    “I will stir up a nation against you, Israel,
  that will oppress you all the way
    from Lebo Hamath to the valley of the Arabah.”

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content:
you who rejoice in the conquest of Lo Debar
    and say, “Did we not take Karnaim by our own strength?”

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content:
You strum away on your harps like David
    and improvise on musical instruments.

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 1

content: If ten people are left in one house, they too will die.

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content: And if the relative who comes to carry the bodies out of the house to burn them asks anyone who might be hiding there, “Is anyone else with you?” and he says, “No,” then he will go on to say, “Hush! We must not mention the name of the Lord.”

teaching.name: Israel is admonished in the present 2

content: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: He was preparing swarms of locusts after the king’s share had been harvested and just as the late crops were coming up.

teaching.name: Visions of the Future

content: When they had stripped the land clean, I cried out, “Sovereign Lord, forgive! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”

teaching.name: Visions of the Future

content: This is what he showed me: The Lord was standing by a wall that had been built true to plumb, with a plumb line in his hand.

teaching.name: Visions of the Future

content:
For this is what Amos is saying:
  “ ‘Jeroboam will die by the sword,
    and Israel will surely go into exile,
    away from their native land.’ ”

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content: Then Amaziah said to Amos, “Get out, you seer! Go back to the land of Judah. Earn your bread there and do your prophesying there.

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content: Amos answered Amaziah, “I was neither a prophet nor the son of a prophet, but I was a shepherd, and I also took care of sycamore-fig trees.

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content:
So the Lord relented.
    “This will not happen either,” the Sovereign Lord said.

teaching.name: Visions of the Future

content:
And the Lord asked me, “What do you see, Amos?”
    “A plumb line,” I replied.
    Then the Lord said, “Look, I am setting a plumb line among my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

teaching.name: Visions of the Future

content: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent a message to Jeroboam king of Israel: “Amos is raising a conspiracy against you in the very heart of Israel. The land cannot bear all his words.

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content: Don’t prophesy anymore at Bethel, because this is the king’s sanctuary and the temple of the kingdom.”

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content:
Now then, hear the word of the Lord. You say,
  “ ‘Do not prophesy against Israel,
    and stop preaching against the descendants of Isaac.’

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content:
“Therefore this is what the Lord says:
  “ ‘Your wife will become a prostitute in the city,
    and your sons and daughters will fall by the sword.
  Your land will be measured and divided up,
    and you yourself will die in a pagan country.
  And Israel will surely go into exile,
    away from their native land.’ ”

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content:
So the Lord relented.
    “This will not happen,” the Lord said.

teaching.name: Visions of the Future

content: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: The Sovereign Lord was calling for judgment by fire; it dried up the great deep and devoured the land.

teaching.name: Visions of the Future

content: Then I cried out, “Sovereign Lord, I beg you, stop! How can Jacob survive? He is so small!”

teaching.name: Visions of the Future
Visions of the Future

content: But the Lord took me from tending the flock and said to me, ‘Go, prophesy to my people Israel.’

teaching.name: Personal Experience of the Prophet Amos

content:
“What do you see, Amos?” he asked.
    “A basket of ripe fruit,” I answered.
    Then the Lord said to me, “The time is ripe for my people Israel; I will spare them no longer.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 1

content:
Hear this, you who trample the needy
    and do away with the poor of the land,

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 1

content:
saying,
  “When will the New Moon be over
    that we may sell grain,
  and the Sabbath be ended
    that we may market wheat?”—
  skimping on the measure,
    boosting the price
    and cheating with dishonest scales,

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 1

content:
I will turn your religious festivals into mourning
    and all your singing into weeping.
  I will make all of you wear sackcloth
    and shave your heads.
  I will make that time like mourning for an only son
    and the end of it like a bitter day.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content:
“The days are coming,” declares the Sovereign Lord,
    “when I will send a famine through the land—
  not a famine of food or a thirst for water,
    but a famine of hearing the words of the Lord.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content:
“Will not the land tremble for this,
    and all who live in it mourn?
  The whole land will rise like the Nile;
    it will be stirred up and then sink
    like the river of Egypt.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content:
“In that day,” declares the Sovereign Lord,
  “I will make the sun go down at noon
    and darken the earth in broad daylight.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content:
Those who swear by the sin of Samaria—
    who say, ‘As surely as your god lives, Dan,’
    or, ‘As surely as the god of Beersheba lives’—
    they will fall, never to rise again.”

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content: This is what the Sovereign Lord showed me: a basket of ripe fruit.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 1

content: “In that day,” declares the Sovereign Lord, “the songs in the temple will turn to wailing. Many, many bodies—flung everywhere! Silence!”

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 1

content:
buying the poor with silver
    and the needy for a pair of sandals,
    selling even the sweepings with the wheat.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 1

content: The Lord has sworn by himself, the Pride of Jacob: “I will never forget anything they have done.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content:
“In that day
  “the lovely young women and strong young men
    will faint because of thirst.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content:
People will stagger from sea to sea
    and wander from north to east,
  searching for the word of the Lord,
    but they will not find it.

teaching.name: Vision of Basket of Summer Fruit 2

content:
All the sinners among my people
    will die by the sword,
  all those who say,
    ‘Disaster will not overtake or meet us.’

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
Though they dig down to the depths below,
    from there my hand will take them.
  Though they climb up to the heavens above,
    from there I will bring them down.

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
Though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel,
    there I will hunt them down and seize them.
  Though they hide from my eyes at the bottom of the sea,
    there I will command the serpent to bite them.

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion
Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
he builds his lofty palace in the heavens
    and sets its foundation on the earth;
  he calls for the waters of the sea
    and pours them out over the face of the land—
    the Lord is his name.

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
and I will bring my people Israel back from exile.
    
  “They will rebuild the ruined cities and live in them.
    They will plant vineyards and drink their wine;
    they will make gardens and eat their fruit.

teaching.name: Regathering and restoration of Israel

content:
I saw the Lord standing by the altar, and he said:
  “Strike the tops of the pillars
    so that the thresholds shake.
  Bring them down on the heads of all the people;
    those who are left I will kill with the sword.
  Not one will get away,
    none will escape.

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
Though they are driven into exile by their enemies,
    there I will command the sword to slay them.
    
  “I will keep my eye on them
    for harm and not for good.”

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
I will plant Israel in their own land,
    never again to be uprooted
    from the land I have given them,”
says the Lord your God.

teaching.name: Regathering and restoration of Israel

content:
“Are not you Israelites
    the same to me as the Cushites?”
    declares the Lord.
  “Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt,
    the Philistines from Caphtor
    and the Arameans from Kir?

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
“Surely the eyes of the Sovereign Lord
    are on the sinful kingdom.
  I will destroy it
    from the face of the earth.
  Yet I will not totally destroy
    the descendants of Jacob,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
“For I will give the command,
    and I will shake the people of Israel
    among all the nations
  as grain is shaken in a sieve,
    and not a pebble will reach the ground.

teaching.name: Vision of world wide dispersion

content:
“In that day
  “I will restore David’s fallen shelter—
    I will repair its broken walls
    and restore its ruins—
    and will rebuild it as it used to be,

teaching.name: Regathering and restoration of Israel

content:
so that they may possess the remnant of Edom
    and all the nations that bear my name,”
    declares the Lord, who will do these things.

teaching.name: Regathering and restoration of Israel

content:
“The days are coming,” declares the Lord,
  “when the reaper will be overtaken by the plowman
    and the planter by the one treading grapes.
  New wine will drip from the mountains
    and flow from all the hills,

teaching.name: Regathering and restoration of Israel
